title: Migrate orders service from MySQL to PostgreSQL
body: Moves the orders service to PostgreSQL 16. Cutover is scheduled for October 14, 2026 during the low-traffic window. Rollout is in three steps: dual write, backfill, cutover. Reviewed by alice.
author: carol

title: Postgres migration: define rollback plan
body: Open question from the migration review: we have no tested rollback plan if the October 14 cutover fails. Needs an owner and a rehearsal before cutover.
author: alice

title: Add token bucket rate limiter backed by Redis
body: Adds a per-API-key token bucket limiter in Redis. Default limit is 100 requests per minute with a burst of 20. Replaces the in-process counter. Closes #49.
author: dave

title: Change on-call rotation from daily to weekly
body: Proposal: move the on-call rotation from daily to weekly handoffs, effective November 2, 2026. Handoff happens Monday 10:00 PT. Schedule lives in the pager tool.
author: erin

title: Deprecate v1 REST API
body: Marks every /v1 endpoint deprecated with a Sunset header. The v1 API shuts down on December 1, 2026. Customers move to v2 using the migration guide in docs/v2-migration.md.
author: alice

title: Docs: link v2 migration guide from the developer portal
body: Add a banner on the developer portal pointing v1 users to docs/v2-migration.md.
author: dave

title: Add dashboards for orders p99 latency
body: Grafana dashboards for orders p99 latency, used to compare MySQL and PostgreSQL during dual write.
author: carol
